holmesConsistency: Holmes is broadly the same man throughout: lean, clean-shaven, dark side-parted hair, long face, brown waistcoat and dark frock coat, and Watson is consistently a brown-haired man with a full moustache, bowler and doctor's bag. The exception is the watercolor Holmes in x016 and x034, where the face shifts into a clear Benedict Cumberbatch likeness.
aliceConsistency: Alice is very consistent across both styles: long straight honey-blonde hair, yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore, pale-blue sash, blue-and-white striped stockings and black strap shoes, sometimes with a black or blue headband. Only her apparent age (roughly 9 to 12) drifts slightly.
